_: The distributor's row-level dimensions (same format as cube/rls_dimensions.json). One: a person or group may be limited to the dealers of some regions; with no rule they see every region (when_empty: allow). The access database is seeded from it (access.sql, generated: python3 scripts/rls_dimensions_sql.py --model models/distributor) and Cube reads this file (docker-compose.distributor.yml).
